title: Meeting Rooms
description: Determine if a person could attend all meetings given a list of intervals.
pseudocode:
1. Sort intervals by start time
2. For i from 0 to n-2:
3. If intervals[i][1] > intervals[i+1][0]: return False
4. Return True

steps.note: Sort intervals by start time: [[0, 30], [5, 10], [15, 20]] becomes [[0, 30], [5, 10], [15, 20]] (Already sorted here, but technically sorting applied).
Compare end of meeting 0 (30) with start of meeting 1 (5). Since 30 > 5, overlap exists.

fullDescription:
Given an array of meeting time intervals where intervals[i] = [starti, endi], determine if a person could attend all meetings.

Example 1:

Input: intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]
Output: false

Example 2:

Input: intervals = [[7,10],[2,4]]
Output: true

Constraints:

  • 0 <= intervals.length <= 104
  • intervals[i].length == 2
  • 0 <= starti < endi <= 106
